guarantees.title: Guarantees I ship
guarantees.intro: Not a skills list. The invariants my systems enforce, each with the project that proves it.

constraint.title: Conflict-free by constraint, not by hope
constraint.detail: Two requests for the same charger in the same minute cannot both win, because a unique index on the occupancy atom decides, not application code.

appendOnly.title: Money is append-only
appendOnly.detail: Invoices get immutable revisions, receipts and refunds are new records, and currencies are never summed together. Any balance can be explained from history.

offline.title: Offline is a first-class state
offline.detail: A van with no signal keeps selling. Every command carries an operation id; replays return the stored result; conflicts are shown to a person.

leastPrivilege.title: Least privilege by default
leastPrivilege.detail: A driver sees stops, contacts and amounts to collect. Never prices, costs or profit. Row-level security makes the rule hold even if a query forgets.

verified.title: Verified, not assumed
verified.detail: Behaviour is written down and checked by a harness: 182 of 182 database-backed checks on ChargeHub, 388 backend tests and real-browser flows on Tawzeevo.

about.title: About
about.p1: I am a full-stack developer who likes systems with rules: who may see what, what may change, and what must never be lost.
about.p2: Computer science degree from the Lebanese International University in 2020. In May 2026 I joined The Digital Hub, UNRWA's full-stack and AI programme, where I led two team projects and built Tawzeevo, ChargeHub and Interview Lab. I plan projects as phase documents and decision logs, and I work with coding agents under review, with tests as the gate.
about.p3: Arabic and English. Based in Saida, open to remote work.
